Title: Applicant opens the references tab from the browse profile page
Step Action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
Step Expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

Step Action: Open the Search disease profiles page
Step Expected: The Search disease profiles page is displayed with the search box and filters

Step Action: Enter "African Horse Sickness" in the Search for disease profiles field
Step Expected: "African Horse Sickness" is shown in the field

Step Action: Click the Search profiles button
Step Expected: The search results list is displayed

Step Action: Tick Display draft versions and click Search profiles
Step Expected: Draft versions are included in the search results

Step Action: Click Browse profile on a draft version that shows the Contributions tab
Step Expected: The profile questions page is displayed with the tabs Summary, References, Further information, Review comments, All Revision dates and Contributions

Step Action: Click the References tab
Step Expected: The References tab content is displayed for the profile section

Step Action: Check the page that is displayed
Step Expected: The edit page for the "References" tab is displayed
